datasets.name: ds_kpi
queryLines:
SELECT
  (SELECT ROUND(MAX(sys_mva), 0) FROM (SELECT forecast_for, SUM(forecast_mva) sys_mva FROM transformer_load_forecast GROUP BY forecast_for)) AS system_peak_forecast_mva,
  (SELECT ROUND(SUM(nameplate_mva), 0) FROM transformers) AS system_nameplate_mva,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transformer_health WHERE forecast_peak_pct > 100) AS transformers_over_nameplate,
  (SELECT SUM(customers_served) FROM transformer_health WHERE overload_risk IN ('CRITICAL','HIGH')) AS customers_at_risk,
  (SELECT MAX(forecast_peak_pct) FROM transformer_health) AS worst_forecast_pct,
  (SELECT ROUND(SUM(saidi_minutes), 1) FROM reliability_monthly WHERE month_start >= add_months((SELECT MAX(month_start) FROM reliability_monthly), -11)) AS saidi_12m,
  (SELECT ROUND(SUM(saifi), 3) FROM reliability_monthly WHERE month_start >= add_months((SELECT MAX(month_start) FROM reliability_monthly), -11)) AS saifi_12m,
  (SELECT ROUND(SUM(customer_minutes_interrupted) / SUM(customers_interrupted), 1) FROM outage_events) AS caidi_12m

datasets.name: ds_system_daily
queryLines:
WITH act AS (
  SELECT CAST(reading_at AS DATE) AS day, reading_at AS ts, SUM(load_mva) AS mva
  FROM transformer_telemetry_hourly
  WHERE reading_at >= (SELECT MAX(reading_at) FROM transformer_telemetry_hourly) - INTERVAL 5 DAYS
  GROUP BY reading_at),
fc AS (
  SELECT CAST(forecast_for AS DATE) AS day, forecast_for AS ts, SUM(forecast_mva) AS mva
  FROM transformer_load_forecast GROUP BY forecast_for),
u AS (SELECT day, mva FROM act UNION ALL SELECT day, mva FROM fc)
SELECT day, ROUND(MAX(mva), 0) AS system_peak_mva
FROM u
WHERE day < (SELECT MAX(CAST(forecast_for AS DATE)) FROM transformer_load_forecast)
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day

datasets.name: ds_curve
datasets.displayName: Most-at-risk transformer: SCADA last 5 days + 48 h forecast vs nameplate
queryLines:
WITH worst AS (SELECT transformer_id FROM transformer_health ORDER BY forecast_peak_pct DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT reading_at AS ts, 'Actual (SCADA)' AS series, load_mva AS mva, transformer_id
FROM transformer_telemetry_hourly
WHERE transformer_id = (SELECT transformer_id FROM worst)
  AND reading_at >= (SELECT MAX(reading_at) FROM transformer_telemetry_hourly) - INTERVAL 5 DAYS
UNION ALL
SELECT forecast_for, 'Forecast', forecast_mva, transformer_id FROM transformer_load_forecast
WHERE transformer_id = (SELECT transformer_id FROM worst)
UNION ALL
SELECT forecast_for, 'Forecast P90', forecast_mva_p90, transformer_id FROM transformer_load_forecast
WHERE transformer_id = (SELECT transformer_id FROM worst)
UNION ALL
SELECT ts, 'Nameplate', nameplate_mva, t.transformer_id FROM (
  SELECT reading_at AS ts FROM transformer_telemetry_hourly
  WHERE transformer_id = (SELECT transformer_id FROM worst)
    AND reading_at >= (SELECT MAX(reading_at) FROM transformer_telemetry_hourly) - INTERVAL 5 DAYS
  UNION ALL SELECT forecast_for FROM transformer_load_forecast WHERE transformer_id = (SELECT transformer_id FROM worst)
) x CROSS JOIN transformers t WHERE t.transformer_id = (SELECT transformer_id FROM worst)

datasets.name: ds_health
queryLines:
SELECT h.transformer_id, h.substation_name, h.nameplate_mva, h.age_years, h.health_index, h.health_tier,
       h.loading_now_pct, ROUND(h.forecast_peak_pct, 0) AS forecast_peak_pct, CONCAT(CAST(ROUND(h.forecast_peak_pct, 0) AS BIGINT), ' %') AS peak_label, date_format(h.forecast_peak_at, 'EEE HH:mm') AS forecast_peak_at,
       CAST(ROUND(h.forecast_peak_hot_spot_c) AS BIGINT) AS forecast_peak_hot_spot_c, h.forecast_hours_over_nameplate, h.dga_status, h.ethylene_ppm,
       h.customers_served, h.critical_facilities, h.overload_risk, h.risk_drivers,
       h.failure_probability_48h, h.replacement_cost_usd, s.latitude, s.longitude
FROM transformer_health h JOIN substations s USING (substation_id)
ORDER BY h.forecast_peak_pct DESC

datasets.name: ds_substation_map
queryLines:
SELECT s.substation_id, s.substation_name, s.latitude, s.longitude,
       MAX(h.forecast_peak_pct) AS worst_forecast_pct, SUM(h.customers_served) AS customers_served
FROM substations s JOIN transformer_health h USING (substation_id)
GROUP BY ALL

datasets.name: ds_options
queryLines:
SELECT transformer_id, recommended_rank, option_type, option_name, CONCAT(recommended_rank, '. ', option_name) AS option_label, relief_at_peak_mva, CAST(ROUND(estimated_cost_usd) AS BIGINT) AS estimated_cost_usd, concat('$', format_number(CAST(ROUND(estimated_cost_usd) AS BIGINT), 0)) AS cost_label,
       customers_affected, customer_impact, CONCAT(CAST(ROUND(post_peak_pct, 0) AS BIGINT), ' %') AS post_peak_label, post_hot_spot_c, clears_overload,
       CASE WHEN n1_redundancy LIKE 'N-1 lost%' THEN 'Lost' ELSE 'Kept' END AS n1_label, n1_redundancy, composite_risk_score
FROM relief_options
ORDER BY recommended_rank

datasets.name: ds_dga
queryLines:
SELECT d.transformer_id, d.sample_date, d.ethylene_ppm, d.acetylene_ppm, d.tdcg_ppm,
       CASE WHEN h.health_tier = 'Poor' THEN d.transformer_id ELSE 'Fleet (other 11)' END AS series
FROM dga_readings d JOIN transformer_health h USING (transformer_id)

datasets.name: ds_hotspot
datasets.displayName: Daily max hot-spot per transformer (90 days)
queryLines:
SELECT transformer_id, date_trunc('DAY', reading_at) AS day, MAX(hot_spot_c) AS max_hot_spot_c, MAX(loading_pct) AS max_loading_pct,
       CASE WHEN transformer_id IN (SELECT transformer_id FROM transformer_health WHERE overload_risk IN ('CRITICAL','HIGH','WATCH')) THEN transformer_id ELSE 'Other' END AS series
FROM transformer_telemetry_hourly
WHERE reading_at >= (SELECT MAX(reading_at) FROM transformer_telemetry_hourly) - INTERVAL 90 DAYS
GROUP BY ALL

datasets.name: ds_reliability
queryLines:
SELECT month_start, saidi_minutes, saifi, caidi_minutes, saidi_target_minutes, outage_events, customers_interrupted
FROM reliability_monthly
WHERE month_start > (SELECT MIN(month_start) FROM reliability_monthly)
  AND month_start < date_trunc('MONTH', (SELECT MAX(reading_at) FROM transformer_telemetry_hourly))

datasets.name: ds_outages
queryLines:
SELECT o.outage_id, o.started_at, o.feeder_id, o.transformer_id, s.substation_name, o.cause, o.protective_device,
       o.customers_interrupted, CAST(ROUND(o.duration_minutes) AS BIGINT) AS duration_minutes, o.customer_minutes_interrupted,
       ROUND(o.customer_minutes_interrupted / (SELECT SUM(customers_total) FROM feeders), 2) AS saidi_contribution_min
FROM outage_events o JOIN substations s USING (substation_id)
ORDER BY customer_minutes_interrupted DESC

# ⚡ MREC Grid Operations — tomorrow's heat-wave peak

Tuesday 21 July 2026, 14:00 — day two of a heat wave, **103°F forecast for Wednesday**. The temperature-aware load forecast says the system has plenty of headroom overall — but **one transformer, T-104 at North Ridge, goes over its nameplate tomorrow evening** with a winding hot-spot above the 120°C emergency limit. It is 39 years old, its dissolved-gas readings have been climbing for six months, and it serves 14,200 customers including Mercy Regional Hospital.

# 🔧 Asset health — why T-104 is the one to worry about

Loading alone doesn't fail a transformer — **heat plus a weak unit** does. T-104's ethylene and acetylene (the gases of an overheating winding) have climbed for six months into IEEE C57.104 Condition 3, and its hot-spot already brushed the 110°C design limit during this week's heat. T-109 at Riverside runs almost as hot, but it is a healthy 2014 unit — **watch, don't act.**

# 📉 Reliability — SAIDI / SAIFI (IEEE 1366)

Last August's T-104 over-temperature trip (14 Aug 2025, 9,800 customers for 5+ hours) is the single largest event of the year — it alone added ~20 minutes to system SAIDI. That is what tomorrow looks like if nobody acts.
